mostWorthwhile.text: Building the turn-sensing canals was most worthwhile: the fluid, flap and bending hairs made the signal's starting point understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the prepared routes to the body was predictable, with only one combination offered, although it completed the picture.

surprise.text: The weighted sensors respond not only to tilt but also to changes in straight-line movement.

arbitrary.text: Joining the weighted sensors to the already-wired turning sensors was the only offered move; the result showed both connected to nerves, but I wasn't sure how that wiring happened in the combination.

continue.text: I would try another chapter: connecting the sensors to a visible eye movement was satisfying, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than the final sequence offered.
